ja.kana.recognition.label: Kana recognition
ja.kana.recognition.description: Hear a sound and pick the matching kana character.

ja.kana.reading.label: Kana reading
ja.kana.reading.description: See a kana character and recall its sound without choices.

ja.kana.writing.label: Kana writing
ja.kana.writing.description: Write a kana character by hand, progressing toward writing from memory.

ja.vocab.recognition.label: Word recognition
ja.vocab.recognition.description: See a Japanese word and pick its meaning.

ja.vocab.recall.label: Word recall
ja.vocab.recall.description: See a meaning and produce the Japanese word without choices.

ja.grammar.sentence.label: Sentence building
ja.grammar.sentence.description: Put words and particles in the right order to express a meaning with the lesson's grammar.

ja.reading.sentence.label: Sentence reading
ja.reading.sentence.description: Read a Japanese sentence and pick its meaning.

ja.listening.sentence.label: Sentence listening
ja.listening.sentence.description: Hear a Japanese sentence and pick its meaning.

ja.listening.word.label: Word listening
ja.listening.word.description: Hear a Japanese word and pick its meaning.

ja.word.writing.label: Word writing
ja.word.writing.description: Write a Japanese word by hand from its meaning, then check it against the model.

ja.sentence.writing.label: Sentence writing
ja.sentence.writing.description: Write a Japanese sentence by hand from its meaning, then check it against the model.

ja.situation.writing.label: Writing in context
ja.situation.writing.description: Respond to a situation by writing in Japanese, then compare with a model.

ja.reading.passage.label: Reading a short text
ja.reading.passage.description: Read a short Japanese text and answer a question about it.

ja.listening.dialogue.label: Listening to a conversation
ja.listening.dialogue.description: Listen to a short conversation and answer a question about it.
